Reviving or being revived grants you and allies within 15 metres a 100HP Overshield for 10 seconds.
Leaving the 15 metres radius removes Overshield
If the wearer loses Overshield, so too does everyone else.

Reviving allies or being revived grants you and allies within 15 meters a 100 HP Overshield for 10 seconds.

Leaving the 15 meter radius or breaking the Overshield of the wearer removes the Overshields.

Kills with a Weapon matching your Subclass Element restore 60 HP to you and allies within 15 meters. 3 second cooldown between heals.

Kills with a Weapon matching your Subclass Element restore 60 HP and grant <solar/>Restoration x1 to you and allies within 15 meters on a 3 second cooldown.

Leaving the 15 meter radius or breaking the Overshield of the wearer removes the Overshields.

Kills with a Weapon matching your Subclass Element grant <solar/>Restoration x1 to you and allies within 15 meters for 3 seconds. 3 second cooldown between activations.

Kills with a Weapon matching your Subclass Element grant <solar/>Restoration x1 to you and allies within 15 meters for 3 seconds. 3 second cooldown between activations.

Reviving allies or being revived projects a 15-meter field around the wearer for 10 seconds that grants the wearer and allies inside it the Shielded buff.

Shielded grants a 100 HP Overshield that regenerates in 1 second as long as it remains active after not receiving damage for 2 seconds.

Shielded is removed if the Overshield is destroyed and you can't regain it by leaving and reentering the field. If the wearer's Overshield is destroyed, the field granting it to allies is removed as well.
